    "picked_cell_type = [\"Ciliated_amphid_neuron\", \"Pharyngeal_neuron\", \"GLR\", \"Glia\",\n",

    "Biological meaning for above choise.\n",
    "Ciliated_Amphid_Neuron  ->  Glia\n",
    "        ->\n",
    "     Pharyngeal_Neuron  <->  Pharyngeal_Muscle  ->  Intestine\n",
    "        ->\n",
    "        ->  GLR  <->  Body_Wall_Muscle\n",

   "source": [
    "cat = pd.Categorical(metadata['cell.type'])\n",
    "colors = cat.codes\n",
    "label_pick = [i for i, name in enumerate(cat.categories) if name in picked_cell_type]\n",
    "\n",
    "from collections import defaultdict\n",
    "def sampling(source, num_sample, label_pick):\n",
    "    class_indices = defaultdict(list)\n",
    "    for idx, label in enumerate(source):\n",
    "        class_indices[label].append(idx)\n",
    "\n",
    "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)  # Set a seed for reproducibility\n",
    "    sampled_indices = []\n",
    "    for label, indices in class_indices.items():\n",
    "        if label in label_pick:\n",
    "            n_class_samples = min(len(indices), num_sample)  # Equal sampling\n",
    "            sampled_indices.extend(list(rng.choice(indices, n_class_samples, replace=False)))\n",
    "    return sampled_indices\n",
    "\n",
    "sampled_indices = sampling(colors, 100, label_pick)"

{"relative_path":"workspace/sample_c_elegans.py","content":"import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# URLs from the notebook
data_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final.txt"
metadata_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final_metadata.txt"

# Load
data = np.loadtxt(data_url, delimiter="\t")
metadata = pd.read_csv(metadata_url, sep=",")

picked_cell_type = ["Ciliated_amphid_neuron", "Pharyngeal_neuron", "GLR", "Glia",
                    "Body_wall_muscle", "Pharyngeal_muscle","Hypodermis", "Intestine"]

from collections import defaultdict

def sampling(source, num_sample, label_pick):
    class_indices = defaultdict(list)
    for idx, label in enumerate(source):
        class_indices[label].append(idx)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)  # Set a seed for reproducibility
    sampled_indices = []
    for label, indices in class_indices.items():
        if label in label_pick:
            n_class_samples = min(len(indices), num_sample)  # Equal sampling
            sampled_indices.extend(list(rng.choice(indices, n_class_samples, replace=False)))
    return sampled_indices

# Use categorical codes as in notebook
cat = pd.Categorical(metadata['cell.type'])
colors = cat.codes
label_pick = [i for i, name in enumerate(cat.categories) if name in picked_cell_type]

sampled_indices = sampling(colors, 100, label_pick)

# Print total count and per-class counts
print('total_sampled', len(sampled_indices))
from collections import Counter
print('counts_per_class', Counter(metadata['cell.type'].values[sampled_indices]))
"}

{"relative_path":"sample_and_count.py","content":"import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

data_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final.txt"
metadata_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final_metadata.txt"

# Load
data = np.loadtxt(data_url, delimiter="\t")
metadata = pd.read_csv(metadata_url, sep=",")

picked_cell_type = ["Ciliated_amphid_neuron", "Pharyngeal_neuron", "GLR", "Glia",
                    "Body_wall_muscle", "Pharyngeal_muscle","Hypodermis", "Intestine"]

cat = pd.Categorical(metadata['cell.type'])
colors = cat.codes
label_pick = [i for i, name in enumerate(cat.categories) if name in picked_cell_type]

from collections import defaultdict

def sampling(source, num_sample, label_pick):
    class_indices = defaultdict(list)
    for idx, label in enumerate(source):
        class_indices[label].append(idx)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)  # Set a seed for reproducibility
    sampled_indices = []
    for label, indices in class_indices.items():
        if label in label_pick:
            n_class_samples = min(len(indices), num_sample)  # Equal sampling
            sampled_indices.extend(list(rng.choice(indices, n_class_samples, replace=False)))
    return sampled_indices

sampled_indices = sampling(colors, 100, label_pick)
print("Total sampled cells:", len(sampled_indices))
# Also print counts per class for inspection
from collections import Counter
print("Counts per picked class:")
classes = pd.Categorical(metadata['cell.type']).categories
counts = Counter([classes[c] for c in pd.Categorical(metadata['cell.type']).codes[sampled_indices]])
for k,v in counts.items():
    print(k, v)
"}
